name: Update video history with additional fields
description: Add orig_prompt, actual_prompt, usage_info, task_id fields to video_history table
sql: ALTER TABLE video_history ADD COLUMN orig_prompt TEXT AFTER prompt
ALTER TABLE video_history ADD COLUMN actual_prompt TEXT AFTER orig_prompt
ALTER TABLE video_history ADD COLUMN usage_info JSON AFTER actual_prompt
ALTER TABLE video_history ADD COLUMN task_id VARCHAR(255) AFTER usage_info
ALTER TABLE video_history ADD INDEX idx_task_id (task_id)
